C6.independent_source_of_truth: the physical EXE + the immutable committed records + the immutable historical implementation
C6.why_non_circular: the no-behavior-change property is proven by equality against the historical implementation re-executed read-only, not by re-asserting the correction
C6.failure_case_detected: any pin/row/field divergence or gate flip would FAIL C6
